children: Twinlab entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell specified business assets to cbdMD's subsidiary, To Be Brands, for $3,979,805. The price consists of a $1.75 million senior secured note bearing 9% interest due in two years and 2,229,805 cbdMD shares valued at $1.00 each, all payable to secured creditor Akretive. The sale, conducted through the Assignee under Florida's ABC process, is subject to court approval and higher bids, with cbdMD as stalking horse. No proceeds are payable to Twinlab; post-closing, Twinlab expects to provide transition services on a cost-recovery basis.
: Asset Purchase Agreement for sale of business assets from assignment estates
: Monetize assets via court-approved sale to repay creditors
